newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Chem sees weak trends continuing.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Chem sees weak trends continuing.

text.p: Sterling Chemicals Holdings Corp said Monday it expected the weakness in the styrene and acrylonitrile markets that hurt its petrochemical business to continue in the coming few months.

Earlier, the company said the results in its petrochemical business for the first quarter of 1997 were significantly lower than the same period in fiscal 1996 primariy because of substantially lower average styrene sales prices and margins.
In addition, acrylonitrile experiened signficantly lower average sale prices and margins and lower sales volumes during the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
Generally, the lower financial performance of both products is attributable to continuing weak market conditions, particularly in the Far East.
In addition, the company said its financial performance was hurt by higher interst expenses related to the increased debt resulting from the recapitalization that occurred in August 1996.
